headline: RV11抗体は、RSVのFタンパク質の2つの抗原部位にまたがる
subhead: 融合前のFと抗体scFvの結晶構造から、S443P耐性変異のしくみも説明できた

summary.question: RSV の予防抗体はより強く効き、保存された部位を狙う新世代のものが求められている。
summary.approach: 回復した小児の記憶 B 細胞から抗体を単離し、融合前 F との複合体を X 線結晶構造解析した。
summary.result: RV11 は融合前 F だけに結合し、3 分子の scFv が F 三量体の腰に付く。分解能は 2.9 Å だった。
summary.learned: RV11 は部位 IV と V にまたがる保存されたエピトープを認識する。S443 の水素結合が失われると耐性になる。
summary.open: マウスでの防御効果と耐性変異の探索は、RSV A 亜型でしか調べていない。

question.quote: A new generation of RSV mAbs with higher specificity to pre-F conformation with higher potency and extended half-life are sought.

approach.quote: Here we report the isolation of two neutralizing mAbs against RSV from convalescent children by prefusion form of fusion (F) glycoprotein as bait.
The crystal structure of RV11 bound to pre-F was determined at a resolution of 2.9 Å (Table S1).

result.quote: In contrast, RV11 bound exclusively to the pre-F with an affinity of 8.4 nM (Figure 1A).
Overall, three RV11 scFv engage around the waist of an RSV pre-F trimer across two adjacent F protomers (Figure 4A).

learned.quote: Crystal structure showed the RV11 bound to a conserved prefusion epitope across the antigenic sites IV and V of the F glycoprotein.
A proline mutation at residue 443 is expected to lose these H-bonds, which explains why the resistant mutants with S443P in F protein evaded neutralization by RV11 as described above.

open.quote: First, the in vivo protection of RV11 was only tested for RSV A subtype.
Secondly, identification of variants resisted to RV11 neutralization was not performed for RSV B subtype strain.

highlights.text: RV11 は A・B 両亜型を中和し、パリビズマブより臨床分離株で 7.1 倍（A）と 58.0 倍（B）強かった。マウスでも 6.3 倍の効力を示した。

evidence.quote: Compared to palivizumab, RV11 was 7.1- and 58.0-fold more potent in neutralizing these RSV A and B clinical strains (Figure 1D and 1E).
The EC90 value of RV11 was 1.5 μg/mL (serum level of mAb), which is 6.3-fold more efficacious than palivizumab (9.5 μg/mL)

highlights.text: 重鎖は一方の F 分子の部位 IV に、軽鎖は隣の F 分子の部位 V に触れる。隣り合う 2 分子を架橋して、融合前から融合後への構造変化を妨げるのではと著者は考える。

evidence.quote: RV11 recognizes epitope at the junction region of pre-F, with its VH contacting site IV residues from one protomer and its VL mainly contacting site V residues from the neighboring protomer
The neutralization mechanism of RV11 may derive from its cross-linking of two protomers that inhibit conformational change required for virus-host membrane fusion during pre-to post–F transition.

highlights.text: 逃避変異体はいずれも S443P を持つ。S443 は RV11 の CDR3 の D112・Y114 と水素結合を作る残基で、変異でこれが失われると説明される。S443 は報告された配列で 99.0% 以上保存されている。

evidence.quote: Notably, residue S443 from β19 of F glycoprotein forms two hydrogen bonds with residues D112 and Y114 from CDR3 of RV11 via its hydroxyl oxygen
Of note, the RV11-escape S443P mutation is not found, and the residue S443 is highly conserved (>99.0%) until May 2023.

lab_notes.expression: 融合前 F は HEK293T で一過性発現。RV11 scFv は大腸菌の封入体から巻き戻した。
lab_notes.construct: sc9-10 DS-Cav1（融合ペプチドを GS リンカーに置換）と RV11 scFv（VL-(GGGGS)4-VH）。
lab_notes.purification: ニッケル親和性とゲルろ過。複合体は 1:2 で混ぜてゲルろ過した。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 10 または 5 mg/mL を 18℃ のシッティングドロップで結晶化した。
lab_notes.data_collection: SSRF BL19U1 で測定。5K6C を探索モデルに分子置換で解いた。

evidence.quote: RSV F proteins were expressed by transient transfection of HEK293T cells.
The RV11 scFv form was constructed as VL-(GGGGS)4-VH form and cloned into the pET21a expression vector
For the RSV-pre-F/RV11 complex, RSV-pre-F was mixed with RV11-scFv at a stoichiometry of 1:2 and incubated on ice for 2 h.
Diffraction-quality crystals of RSV-pre-F/RV11-scFv were obtained at 18 °C
The RSV-pre-F/RV11-scFv dataset was collected at BL19U1.
